title: Lumen Current: Signal Garden
tagline: Ride a living current of light and rekindle three signal nodes before the storm pressure snuffs the garden out.
pitch: You are a ribbon of bioluminescent light drifting through a dark glass conservatory. Three dormant signal nodes pulse faintly in the gloom while storm pressure drains and thorn-pulses sweep faster the lower it falls. Reach each node, hold your light inside its ring, and press Space to root the signal — every activation floods the garden with color and buys you tense seconds more.
coreLoop: Steer the light current across the single-screen garden toward the next glowing node while drifting thorn hazards accelerate; enter a node's ring and press Space to activate it, restoring pressure and score, then push to the next node as hazards speed up.

mechanics.name: Light Current Movement
mechanics.description: Smooth top-down movement with Arrow keys or WASD; the current leaves a fading luminous trail and gentle motion sparks.

mechanics.name: Node Attunement
mechanics.description: Each of the three signal nodes has a visible ring. Standing inside the ring and pressing Space (or Enter) begins a 0.6s attunement channel; completing it activates the node with a shockwave, +100 score, +12 pressure restored, and permanent garden illumination. Each activation emits a node_activated event carrying nodesBefore and nodesAfter values.

mechanics.name: Storm Pressure
mechanics.description: A visible pressure bar drains continuously from 100 to 0 over ~75 seconds. Reaching 0 ends the run in failure. Node activation restores pressure, creating a push-your-luck route.

mechanics.name: Escalating Thorn Pulses
mechanics.description: Non-combat drifting thorn orbs bounce around the garden. Their speed scales directly with pressure depletion (speed = base * (1 + 1.5 * (1 - pressure/100))); whenever the computed speed crosses a 10% step the game emits a hazard_speed_up event carrying speedBefore and speedAfter values. Touching a thorn costs 10 pressure with knockback — pressure escalation changes real gameplay values, not just color.

mechanics.name: Run Restart
mechanics.description: On success or failure, Enter immediately starts a fresh run: nodes reset to dormant, pressure resets to 100, score resets to 0. The restart emits a run_restarted event carrying nodesBefore (terminal node count) and nodesAfter (0).

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys / WASD to move; Space or Enter to attune nodes and to start/restart runs
controls.mouse: Optional: cursor shows a faint lure glow the current drifts toward when moving via click-hold

artDirection.mood: bioluminescent conservatory — dark glass, water reflections, elegant botanical circuitry
artDirection.backgroundFx: Two parallax layers of drifting spore motes and a slow-shifting deep-teal radial gradient; faint botanical circuit veins pulse gently across the floor, brightening permanently in regions where nodes have been activated.

audioDirection.musicMood: ambient, warm synth pads with a soft pulse that quickens as pressure falls

difficulty.start: Pressure drains slowly, two slow thorn orbs, generous node rings; first node is a short straight glide from spawn
difficulty.progression: Each activation restores pressure but thorn speed scales up with pressure depletion; a third thorn orb joins after the first activation
difficulty.peak: Final node approach with pressure below 30%: fast thorns, warning ticks, tight margins — still fair because thorn paths are readable and node rings are large

winLose.win: Activate all three signal nodes before pressure hits zero — success state with a garden bloom sequence and final score
winLose.lose: Storm pressure reaches 0 — failure state with the garden dimming out

juice.screenShake: Small 5px shake on thorn hit; 3px pulse on node activation
juice.particles: Burst of light petals on node activation, spark trail on movement, dim shard burst on thorn hit, slow falling motes on failure
juice.hitStop: 60ms hit-stop on node activation completion for weight
juice.flash: Soft teal flash alpha 0.35 on activation; red-tinged vignette pulse when pressure < 20%

scopeNotes: Cut: weapons/projectiles of any kind, enemies with health or combat AI, shops/inventory/upgrades/persistent meta, scrolling camera (single 960x540 screen), touch controls, multiple levels, boss entities, save system, narrative cutscenes. Only three nodes, one hazard type, one pressure resource.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: During an active run the player entity's top-down position changes in response to Arrow/WASD input, and Space/Enter performs the primary node-attunement action, evidenced by player_moved events whose payload x value changes from its prior value (fields before/after).

During a run the player activates three signal nodes; each activation increments the nodesActivated run value and raises score by 100, proven by node_activated events carrying nodesBefore and nodesAfter values where nodesAfter = nodesBefore + 1.
After the third node is activated the game transitions to the success state with a visible victory overlay.
When the visible storm pressure resource reaches 0 the game transitions to the failure state with a visible defeat overlay.

After a terminal success or failure state, pressing Enter starts a fresh run in which nodesActivated resets from its terminal value back to 0, proven by a run_restarted event carrying nodesBefore (terminal count) and nodesAfter (0).

During active gameplay the HUD renders at least three distinct non-overlapping in-bounds regions: node progress (top-left), storm pressure bar (top-right), and score (top-center), leaving the central play area unobscured.
During a run the thorn hazard speed numeric value increases as pressure depletes, proven by hazard_speed_up events carrying speedBefore and speedAfter values where speedAfter > speedBefore.
No projectile_fired, weapon, or combat event is ever emitted during any run.
No shop_opened, inventory, or purchase event is ever emitted during any run.
No node_auto_activated event is ever emitted; node activation occurs only via the player's Space/Enter attunement input inside a node ring.

scoreEvents: +100 score per signal node activated (node_activated); deterministic verifier sweeps pass through node rings and its 750ms action cadence presses Space, so activations and score increases occur without lucky spawns — node rings (radius 70px) are placed along the sweep corridors: node 1 right of center, node 2 lower-left, node 3 upper-center

actionPolicy.designBoundary: Required deterministic gameplay must be reachable under generic bounded directional sweeps and ordinary action/pointer input; do not depend on hidden routes, target coordinates, precision-only aim, or verifier-specific backdoors.

scenarios.purpose: prove real successful completion under deterministic active input
prove real timeout/failure independently from success
